Aino, Elina, Sanna, Laura, every business and every figure here are invented. The synthetic data set (about 32,000 rows) is in the synthetic-data folder next to this file. Kanta, Kela, Google and the wellbeing services aids unit are named to show where such data lives; this demo is not connected to them. Kestrel Air, Rata Rail, Hotel Strandkajen, Strandkajen Bistro, Kajhallen Concert Hall, Hotel Merikaari, Merikaari Bistro, Satama Concert Hall, Vakaa Insurance and Kaleva Bank are imaginary.
